title: Pricing SKU consolidation — phased entitlements & go-to-market choreography
creator: Sophie Park
description:
Objective: Replace current fragmented SKU matrix with a simplified three-tier SKU surface and aligned limits, migrate entitlements and billing mappings with zero invoice regressions, and coordinate cross-functional launch (docs, release notes, sales enablement, and support runbooks).

Scope:
- Canonicalize SKUs for Hosted API, Dedicated, and Private deployments.
- Migrate existing entitlements and usage buckets to the new SKU identifiers in billing metadata and entitlement service.
- Enforce new per-SKU limits (concurrency, tokens/day) with configurable grace windows.
- Release comms: customer-facing release notes, targeted billing emails, partner notifications, and internal playbooks for Sales/Support/Finance.
- Sales enablement: pricing cheat sheet, objection handling, quoting templates, and training sessions.

Success criteria:
- 100% of customers have accurate mapped entitlements or migrations scheduled before billing cutover.
- No undetected overcharges or missing invoices in first 30 days after cutover.
- Sales and Support report >= 90% confidence on new SKU messaging in training surveys.

Out of scope: one-off contractual repricing (handled by RevOps/Enterprise sales), changes to token/unit definitions, or altering ratecards outside this SKU consolidation.

operational_plan_summary: Phased cutover: 1) Publish SKU mapping and notify customers of effective date (T-21d), 2) Run entitlement migration in sandbox and reconcile (T-14d), 3) Execute canary on 10% of accounts with no discounts (T-7d), 4) Full migration (T0) with live invoice monitoring for 72 hours, 5) Post-migration reconciliation and fixups (T+7d). Rollback plan triggers: invoice rendering errors >0.5% of migrated accounts or reconciliation delta > $5k/day.
communication_plan_summary: Multichannel communications: public release notes, personalized billing emails to accounts with billing changes, partner notifications, internal all-hands for Sales/Support/Finance. Templates and send cadence maintained in Drive. Escalation matrix included in Support playbook.
training_plan_summary: Two 45-minute live sessions for Sales and Support (recorded), tabletop scenario run-throughs, and an internal FAQ in Confluence. Completion required for sales reps handling enterprise renewals.
